productGoal: AgriLearn AI is an agricultural smart application that uses artificial intelligence to scan crops, interpret weather and environmental data, provide rapid educational diagnostics, deliver early warnings, and offer localized farming guidance that helps farmers prevent losses, use water and farm inputs more efficiently, and improve productivity.
safetyGates: No definitive diagnosis without confidence and alternatives
No exact chemical or fertilizer rate without location, crop stage, label and agronomist validation
Display source, timestamp and geographic coverage for alerts
Separate educational guidance from regulated treatment instructions
Human escalation for severe or uncertain cases
